outOfSupportedRangeObservations.policy: Unusable observations outside the supported game terrain range are distinct from the exact provider NoData sentinel/null. Raw response bodies and per-observation reportedZ/coordinates/hashes are preserved. providerInvalidPoints is a compatibility alias, not a claim that every unsupported observation is a provider error or physical bathymetry. No altitude is clamped or invented.
